document.title: Support Windows and PowerShell in the CLI and skill
document.summary: The CLI accepts Windows paths and the files PowerShell writes, the repo checks out with LF on every OS, and the skill gets PowerShell blocks plus a shell check. Separately, the API runs its independent git reads in parallel.
document.why: The skill and the CLI must work on Windows in PowerShell, and stay as good on Linux and macOS in bash and zsh. Agents must find out which shell they run in [and adapt](source:s1).

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 25
sources.gist: Make the skill and CLI work on Windows (PowerShell) without hurting Linux and macOS (bash, zsh); agents detect their shell and adapt.

sources.label: Support Windows and PowerShell in the CLI and skill

lookFor: Breaking: the published skill in `skills/comprehende/` and the npm `comprehende@0.11.0` CLI still have the Windows `serve` bug. Windows users get the fix only after a release and `pnpm release:skill`.

parts.name: Windows support
parts.summary: The CLI, the skill, the tests, and the repo checkout work on Windows and in PowerShell.

parts.name: Parallel git reads
parts.summary: The API and `validate` start independent git reads together instead of one after another.

groups.title: serve accepts Windows paths
groups.why: On Windows, `serve` answered 400 invalid path for every page and file, so the UI did not load.
groups.summary: `resolveInsideRoot` in `src/git/repo.ts` compares the resolved path against the root plus the platform separator instead of `/`.

groups.title: Read review.json in PowerShell encodings
groups.why: PowerShell 5.1 writes UTF-8 with a BOM, and its `>` writes UTF-16LE, so `validate` and `serve` rejected those files as invalid JSON.
groups.summary: `loadDocument` reads bytes and `decodeText` picks UTF-16LE from its BOM, else UTF-8 with the BOM dropped; the test writes all three encodings.

groups.title: LF checkout and slash keys on every OS
groups.why: Git for Windows defaults to `core.autocrlf=true`, and the skill sync and schema checks compare bytes, so they failed on every Windows checkout.
groups.summary: `.gitattributes` pins LF; `skill-sync.ts` keys its file maps with `/`, so the working tree and the staged tree compare equal; the pages test clones with `core.autocrlf=false`; CONTRIBUTING explains the `.claude/skills` symlink on Windows.
lookFor: Subtle: a Windows clone made before this commit keeps its CRLF working files. `check:skill` still fails there until the files are checked out again.

groups.title: Tests and fixture output run on Windows
groups.why: Some tests assumed `which`, a bash shim on PATH, and fast process spawns, and the fixture printed backslash paths.
groups.summary: The three `commands.test.ts` tests that count git calls through a bash shim skip only on win32, `vite.config.ts` raises the timeout only on win32, and `build-fixture.ts` prints forward-slash paths.

groups.title: Skill detects the shell and has PowerShell blocks
groups.why: Agents must find out which shell they run in [and adapt](source:s1).
groups.summary: SKILL.md names bash, zsh, or PowerShell, and points a PowerShell agent at `references/powershell.md`, which replaces the blocks of Workflow steps 2 and 4 and of Refresh; README states the supported shells.

groups.title: Synced agent skill copy
groups.why: `pnpm sync:skill` writes this copy for agents that work in this repo.
groups.summary: Generated output of `pnpm sync:skill`, the same text as `skills-next/comprehende`; skip it.

groups.title: Independent git reads run in parallel
groups.why: Each git spawn costs about 100 ms on Windows, and `openReview` ran its reads one after another.
groups.summary: `openReview` in `live.ts` starts coverage, comment pins, commits, repo identity, and the previous review together; `readDiff` resolves base and head together; `staleCommentPins` checks every pin at once.
lookFor: Perf: `staleCommentPins` starts one `git show` per pinned comment at the same moment, with no limit. A review with 200 pinned comments spawns 200 git processes at once.
Subtle: when two reads in `openReview` fail, the error that reaches the caller is the first to reject in time, not the first in the old order.

commits.subject: Support Windows and PowerShell in the CLI and skill
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- serve: resolveInsideRoot compares with the platform separator, so
  Windows no longer answers 400 "invalid path" for every file.
- loadDocument reads UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, and UTF-16LE, the encodings
  PowerShell 5.1 writes.
- skill-sync keys use "/" on every OS; .gitattributes pins LF so the
  byte-for-byte skill and schema checks pass under core.autocrlf=true.
- openReview, readDiff, and staleCommentPins run independent git reads
  in parallel: about 35% faster API responses on Windows and macOS.
- Skill: shell detection, and references/powershell.md replaces the
  blocks of Workflow steps 2 and 4 and of Refresh. The Refresh copy
  block prints the review folder.
- Tests: the git log shim tests skip on win32, longer timeout on win32,
  pages-review clone reads published bytes.
